converterVersion: 1.0 (2026-08-19, format v7 as of Resonalyze d11186e)
note: VW Passat B8 sedan (LHD), front set _01 measured 2026-06-15: sub (sealed box, trunk), door woofers L/R, A-pillar mids L/R, tweeters L/R, dash centre; Helix DSP Ultra S at 96 kHz; Behringer ECM8000 on a Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 4th gen, physical loopback (output R -> input 2), REW 5.40 sweeps 20 Hz-20 kHz, one sweep each, output channel L. Drivers played 'clean' except the protective high-passes the physics demands (mids/centre 100 Hz LR24, tweeters 1 kHz LR24) - see rewSource.protectiveHighPass and the compensated set.
